description.html: This ready-made decoration combines a dark brown, branching root with lush artificial plants. Green leaves of various shapes grow from the root, along with sprigs of tiny yellow flowers, a pink flower and spiral shoots that look like young fern fronds. The result is a vivid green bush that instantly livens up even an empty aquarium or terrarium.

Artificial plants do not wilt, need no light or fertilizer and do not rot, so they are a practical solution for beginners and for setups where live plants would not survive. In an aquarium, fish use the dense foliage as shelter and a resting place, and in a terrarium, geckos, lizards and amphibians hide under the branches. One piece is enough to fill a corner or the foreground.

Rinse the decoration with lukewarm water before use. Place the root on the bottom and press it lightly into the substrate so the plants stand upright and the decoration does not tip over. When algae or dust settles on the leaves, rinse them under running water and gently brush them with a soft brush. If your animal tends to chew on plants, keep an eye on it, because artificial leaves are not food.
